profile_text: With a strong presence in Düsseldorf, Germany, this metal industry specialist has experienced remarkable growth of 182.4% since its baseline, driven by its expertise in metal trading and distribution. As a key player in the industry, it has successfully expanded its operations, increasing its employee base to 48 in 2024. Its focus on connecting buyers and sellers in the metal market has enabled it to capitalize on market trends and establish itself as a leading scaler in the sector.
